anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: After keeps every fact Before kept: Checkpoint 1 rewrites Idea as a single attributed sentence that names src/report-helper.ts and the reporter's ExportWrapper proposal with the docs/export.md:8 citation, carries the sketch verbatim into a new Reporter note without implying reporter endorsement, surfaces the repo-fit line at the one existing gate, and the AC-only checkpoint restates the row around the 12-row observable (no wrapper, no helper), notes the displaced mechanism row verbatim, routes through normalized full replacement and reports the cited ac-fit, with no human question or new blocking state. Two things to watch so this stays stable: After's diff removes 'Build a new ExportWrapper around report downloads.' as the old Idea line (treating the sketch as the current snapshot text) whereas Before removed the base line; that is a defensible reading of 'Replace Idea with...' but the wording should state which text is the pre-repair baseline so a reader does not think the base Idea was silently lost. Second, 'Roast dispositions: not yet run' is close to reading as a pending precondition; phrasing it as Before did ('prescribed before this gate; applied: none recorded; surfaced-ambiguous: none recorded') makes it unambiguous that the gate is live now and that the roast is a described call, not a blocker, while still delivering the new draft-artifact and dispatch wording from the Change.
